title: Leak localisation with a measure source convection-diffusion model
summary: Taking a variational approach, study the inverse problem of locating gas leaks from line-of-sight concentration measurements using a convection--diffusion model with the source term a Radon measure. By imposing sparsity-promoting regularisation on this measure, we recover point sources---identifying both their locations and intensities---rather than diffuse approximations. We jointly estimate the underlying physical convection (wind) and diffusion parameters.
